coverage.summary: The Rent Board rates page gives only the annual security deposit interest rate (4.2% for March 1, 2026 – February 28, 2027). It does not say which buildings, units or owners are covered, or what exemptions apply.

result.notes: Removed the summary's claim that Cal. Civ. Code § 1950.5 deposit cap and return rules apply alongside this requirement. No document mentions § 1950.5 or how the state and local deposit rules relate. For the same reason, supersedes_state_rule changed from false to null. D083 is the only relevant document and gives rates only, with no coverage scope, unit thresholds, construction-date limits or exemptions. D079 discusses Rent Ordinance coverage for evictions, not deposit interest, so it cannot be used for this rule. All other coverage fields stay null pending the underlying ordinance text.
